snippet.title: Robo Miner
snippet.description:
Robo Miner is a digging game for android devices - very addictive, very funny, generic mines, dynamite, falling blocks - hard times for the little robot to find the Ultimate Diamonds!

The game is completely free and available on different stores! Get it now and play down your battery ;-)

Check out Robo Miner (Remastered): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rnet.RoboMinerRM
